title: Naturality of the finite-stage tensor model and the canonical inclusion tensorator
statement: In the setting of [def-sf-common-stage-inclusion-tensor-model], the finite-stage model isomorphism is natural in K and L. For any a:K→K_prime and b:L→L_prime, the common tensor of i_E a and i_E b followed by the target model isomorphism equals the source model isomorphism followed by inclusion of the rational tensor of T_EE a and T_EE b. Compose this natural model isomorphism with the rational tensor of the two canonical scalar units, and invert, to obtain a natural isomorphism rationalTensor;i_E ≅ (i_E×i_E);commonTensor. The common tensor and its morphism formula are those of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the scalar units are those of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients].

source.place: Compatibility and the common finite coefficient-field paragraph: flat extension of scalars respects the units, counits, associativity and specified projection mate.

proof.text: Apply the common-stage tensor representative formula to the two arrows extended by T_EE. Express its representative using isoToStage. A general categorical cancellation lemma cancels the target model isomorphism and yields naturality. The scalar unit is a natural isomorphism, so product, whiskering and inversion construct the natural inclusion tensorator.

Construct the identical tensorator directly from its inverse corrected-model components using NatIso.ofComponents. The generic tensoratorFromModel_naturality theorem supplies naturality from the already proved model naturality. This replaces nested natural-isomorphism projections by their explicit component data without changing the tensorator maps.

mathlib_searches.query: A functor preserves a proper adjunction projection mate when it preserves the tensor pullback comparison and the adjunction counit
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits on categorical pullbacks, functorialityCounit, Frobenius mates and adjunctions. None gives this coefficient-stage comparison.
NatIso.ofComponents and its component formulas construct the natural tensorator; no common-stage projection-factor theorem.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic construction used; no matching factor compatibility.

mathlib_searches.results: Existing stageTensor specifies object components only. The supplied projection is literally a composite of the proper counit mate and proper image of open projection, with support identifications. No canonical common-stage factor square found.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the existing formula and isolate its two actual factors.

lean.statement:
theorem commonInclusionTensorModel_naturality
    {K K' L L' : Stage l Ω W E} (a : K ⟶ K') (b : L ⟶ L') :
    (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω W).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((inclusion (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := W) E).map a)
          ((inclusion (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := W) E).map b)) ≫
        (commonInclusionTensorModel l Ω W E K' L').hom =
      (commonInclusionTensorModel l Ω W E K L).hom ≫
        (inclusion (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := W) E).map
          ((rationalDerivedTensor l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) W).map
            (Prod.mkHom (((stageSystem l Ω W).T (le_rfl : E ≤ E)).map a)
              (((stageSystem l Ω W).T (le_rfl : E ≤ E)).map b)))
